title: What is 'SlopSquatting'?
summary: Tanya Janca's one-minute definition of slopsquatting.

assertions.quote: an AI has hallucinated the name of a library or a package and then a malicious actor goes and builds that package

verdicts.note: The USENIX Security 2025 study (Spracklen et al.) measured these rates and found many hallucinated names recur, making them registrable attack targets.
